The May Administration Platform has moved from backend capability (S252-S262) to operational Phase 1 deployment (S263-S266). A single administrator can now investigate any question, trace any challenge, follow any investigation lifecycle, and reconstruct any certification timeline — all through a unified dashboard without manual report traversal.
